subject: Startups
title: Mission-Driven vs. Mercenary Culture
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Mission-Driven vs. Mercenary Culture.

hook.text: Patagonia employees take surf breaks during work. Goldman Sachs analysts work 100-hour weeks.

buildup.text: Mission-driven cultures attract true believers. Mercenary cultures attract ambitious achievers.

discovery.text: John Doerr coined the terms: missionaries build for impact, mercenaries build for exits. The purest companies have both.

twist.text: Pure missionaries risk building something beautiful that nobody pays for.

climax.text: The best startups hire missionaries who understand markets. Passion plus pragmatism is the winning combination.

punchline.text: Passion builds products. Pragmatism builds businesses. You need both.

quiz.question: Who coined the 'missionaries vs. mercenaries' framework?
